title: The specified bounded exchange is the ambient mate
statement: For the finite-type separated scheme square over a field and coefficient ring in the domain of boundedConstructibleBaseChange, the underlying ambient morphism of its component at every bounded constructible K equals the ambient exchange component of [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-ambient]. This is equality of specified morphisms and requires neither properness nor Cartesianity.

proof.text: The fully faithful restriction counit has the same underlying component as the original derived adjunction because the compatibility isomorphisms are identities. Apply map_restrictFullyFaithful_counit_app and simplify identities.

The underlying bounded pull composition constraints are the original derived constraints. Objectwise transport of equality commutes with full-subcategory inclusion; replace functor transport by its equal componentwise construction.

Apply injectivity of the ambient f-prime inverse hom equivalence. Use the existing boundedConstructibleBaseChange_adjunct API for the specified restricted exchange, obtained from the canonical squareExchange presentation. Map this equality through inclusion and substitute the counit and square component identities. Its right side is the adjunct of the ambient mate by residueExchangeBaseChange_counit.
